reviewNotes: Unreviewed AI translation drafts for Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans), Vietnamese (vi), and Thai (th) field seed UI copy. Intended drafting boundaries: (1) Absence of a nursery phase describes an operational planning distinction without implying biological impossibility or proving botanical direct sowing; (2) Whole-seed requirements and counts in rows 02 and 08 are translated as integer seed numbers and gross totals rather than unbroken physical integrity or dehusked quality; (3) Explicit material declaration is maintained without conflating vegetative and botanical items; (4) Exact ASCII literals DEMO and CSV are preserved verbatim; (5) Blank remains unknown while confirmed zero is an explicit planning entry. Drafting corrections applied: removed physical-quality terms (整粒 in zh-Hans, hạt nguyên in vi, เต็มเมล็ด in th) in favor of gross integer seed counts; corrected zh-Hans row 01 from crop rotation (轮作) to planting cycles (种植周期); restored Unknown (ไม่ทราบ) alongside not declared in th row 05; and broadened whitespace coverage in zh-Hans row 12 beyond simple spaces. Remaining checks for human reviewers: verify horticultural naturalness in local agricultural contexts. No runtime language activation or semantic certification is claimed.
